title: Healthy Blueberry Yogurt Mousse
excerpt: Make a delicious blueberry and yogurt mousse with a soft, creamy texture, perfect to treat your family at any time.
imageAlt: Small crystal cup of soft purple blueberry mousse, decorated with whole fresh blueberries on top.
steps: Hydrate the unflavored gelatin in the four tablespoons of water for five minutes and microwave it for ten seconds until completely liquid.
Wash your high-mountain blueberries grown in Guasca very well and place them in the blender with the honey and the Greek yogurt.
Blend on medium speed until you get an even mixture with a bright purple color.
Add the dissolved gelatin in a thin stream while blending on low speed so it combines perfectly with the blueberry mixture.
Divide the mousse into four individual containers or small glass cups.
Refrigerate the containers for at least sixty minutes so they reach the ideal firm, creamy consistency.
tips: You can set aside a few unwashed whole blueberries in the fridge to add as a crunchy decoration right before serving.
To better preserve the texture and freshness of your blueberries, keep them in their original packaging in the coldest part of the fridge, unwashed, until you are ready to eat them.
